about: Modwerk source-only scene-mutes package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/scene-mutes.

mods.title: Scene Mutes
mods.summary: Each scene can carry its own track mutes: engage the scene and the mutes change with it.
mods.description: In scene edit, FUNC + T1..T13 builds the edited scene's mute mask (T13 is FX), shown on the trig keys while FUNC is held. Engaging a marked scene sets the mutes; an unmarked scene, or none, puts back the mutes from before. CLEAR and CLEAR ALL also drop the masks. A port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0018-scene-mutes, with his code unchanged.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: Not run on a unit yet. In rytm-emu on OS 1.74 with core-ar2 0.7, engaging a scene with T1 and T2 in its mask muted BD and SD, and disengaging unmuted them.
